Devotee Donates Land and Silver Canopy to Sanwaliya Seth Temple

A devotee has donated approximately 10 bighas of land to the Sanwaliya Seth temple. The devotee also offered a 3-kilogram silver canopy. The donation was made from Gurugram, highlighting significant religious offerings to the deity.
